caption.opening: If your RAG answers feel half-right, look at where your chunks end.
body:
Fixed-size chunking (say, every 500 tokens) cuts documents wherever the counter runs out:
→ table headers split from their rows
→ a rule in one chunk, its exception in the next
→ step 7 retrieved without steps 1–6

Chunk by structure instead:
→ split on headings and sections
→ keep tables and numbered steps whole
→ prefix each chunk with its document title
Then re-run your retrieval checks on the questions that failed. (The document examples in the reel are illustrative.)

claims.text: Structure-aware chunking (by headings, sections and whole tables) usually retrieves more complete context than fixed-size chunking.
The refund policy, pricing table and setup guide examples are illustrative.
